current_activity: becoming operational at Rennes under Simpson
notes: Event date: Breakout-30 p636: Ninth Army became operational at Rennes on 5 September; VIII Corps passed to it five days later (see conflict group G013). Event definition: the army becomes operational. Relationship: assigned to 12th Army Group (Pogue, Supreme Command ch. 15). Location: Rennes, named by the Green Book for the headquarters; point is the town centroid.

composing_units: VIII Corps; 6th Armored Division; 83rd Infantry Division
current_activity: taking VIII Corps from Third Army and placing 6th Armored and 83rd Divisions under army control
notes: Event date: Breakout-30 p636: VIII Corps passed from Third Army to Ninth Army on 10 September; Ninth Army was operational at Rennes on 5 September. Event definition: Ninth Army takes over the Brest operation through VIII Corps (operational control) and, so that Middleton can concentrate on Brest, puts the 6th Armored and 83rd Divisions directly under army control (the date for the two divisions is "almost immediately afterwards" in the text; the CMH tables show the 83rd under Ninth Army with no corps from 10 September). Location: the CMH command-post list gives Ninth Army at Rennes on 8 September, two days before. Relationship: 12th Army Group assigned from 5 September.
